metadata.name: market_escrow
metadata.description: FlaconVault Market — non-custodial stablecoin escrow for marketplace orders (blueprint §7.2, §7.3)

instructions.name: accept_settlement
docs: The other party accepts exactly the open proposal → split, no fees.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The party that did not make the open proposal.

instructions.name: close_order
docs: Anyone: closes a terminal order and its vault after the offer expired; rent → rent payer.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: Required only when the vault is not empty.

instructions.name: collect_fees
docs: Anyone: forwards a fee vault to the fee recipient's associated token account.

instructions.name: confirm
docs: Buyer: received (SHIPPED), or withdraws a dispute (DISPUTED) → release.

instructions.name: dispute
docs: Buyer or arbiter: halts a SHIPPED order inside its review window (moves no money).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The buyer or the arbiter.

instructions.name: execute_ruling
docs: Anyone, after the timelock: carries out the ruling.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: Required for a REFUND ruling.

accounts.name: seller_token
docs: Required for a RELEASE ruling.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Once, by the program's upgrade authority: offer key, arbiter, fee recipient and the two allowed
mints (USDC, EURC; classic SPL Token, 6 decimals). Creates the fee vault of each mint. There is no
instruction that changes any of it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority; pays the rent of the config and the fee vaults.

accounts.name: usdc_fee_vault
docs: Fee vault of `usdc_mint`, owned by the config PDA. (`init_if_needed`: passing the same mint twice
then fails the duplicate-account check instead of a raw "already in use".)

accounts.name: program
docs: This program; only its upgrade authority may create the config (no front-running a fresh deploy).

instructions.name: mark_shipped
docs: Seller: shipped (until the ship deadline). Starts the review window of the lane.

instructions.name: open_and_deposit
docs: Buyer: opens the order `["morder", buyer, order_id]` and deposits `amount + buyer_fee`. Must
directly follow an Ed25519 instruction with the offer key's signature over the terms (`offer.rs`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Token account `["vault", order]` holding the deposit, authority = the order PDA.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: Source of the deposit (any token account of the buyer for `mint`).

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays the rent of `order` and `vault`; may be the buyer.

instructions.name: propose_settlement
docs: Buyer or seller: proposes how much of the deposit goes back to the buyer (DISPUTED or RULED).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The buyer or the seller.

instructions.name: refund_after_tmax
docs: Anyone: DISPUTED and no ruling by T_max → full refund.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The buyer's associated token account for the order's mint.

instructions.name: refund_unshipped
docs: Anyone: PAID and the ship deadline passed → full refund.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The buyer's associated token account for the order's mint.

instructions.name: release_after_window
docs: Anyone: SHIPPED and the review window passed without a dispute → release.

accounts.name: seller_token
docs: The seller's associated token account for the order's mint.

instructions.name: rule
docs: Arbiter: `RULING_RELEASE` or `RULING_REFUND` before T_max, with the hash of the published
reasons; starts the order's timelock (moves no money).

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may create the config

errors.name: InvalidKey
errors.msg: Key must not be the default pubkey

errors.name: OfferKeyIsArbiter
errors.msg: The offer key and the arbiter must be different keys

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint must be a classic SPL Token mint with 6 decimals

errors.name: DuplicateMint
errors.msg: USDC and EURC must be two different mints

errors.name: MintNotAllowed
errors.msg: Mint is not allowed by the config

errors.name: InvalidInstructionsSysvar
errors.msg: Not the instructions sysvar

errors.name: MissingOfferSignature
errors.msg: open_and_deposit must directly follow an Ed25519 instruction with the signed offer

errors.name: MalformedEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: Malformed Ed25519 instruction (one signature, data in the instruction itself, 201-byte offer)

errors.name: OfferKeyMismatch
errors.msg: The offer is not signed by the config's offer key

errors.name: OfferMismatch
errors.msg: The signed offer differs from the order terms, the buyer, the mint or this program

errors.name: OfferExpired
errors.msg: The signed offer has expired

errors.name: OfferExpiryTooFar
errors.msg: The offer expiry lies more than MAX_OFFER_TTL_S in the future

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: amount must be > 0 and amount + buyer_fee must fit in u64

errors.name: FeeTooHigh

errors.name: InvalidLane

errors.name: LaneNotSupported

errors.name: InvalidShipDeadline
errors.msg: ship_deadline must lie MIN_SHIP_WINDOW_S ..= MAX_SHIP_WINDOW_S after now

errors.name: InvalidRulingWindow
errors.msg: ruling_window_s must be within MIN_RULING_WINDOW_S ..= MAX_RULING_WINDOW_S

errors.name: InvalidTimelock
errors.msg: timelock_s must be within MIN_TIMELOCK_S ..= MAX_TIMELOCK_S

errors.name: InvalidSeller
errors.msg: Seller must be a wallet other than the buyer and the arbiter

errors.name: BuyerIsArbiter
errors.msg: The buyer must not be the arbiter

errors.name: OrderAlreadyExists
errors.msg: An order with this id already exists for this buyer

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.msg: Order is not in the required state for this instruction

errors.name: NotBuyer
errors.msg: Signer is not the order's buyer

errors.name: NotSeller
errors.msg: Signer is not the order's seller

errors.name: NotArbiter
errors.msg: Signer is not the arbiter

errors.name: NotParty
errors.msg: Signer is not entitled to this instruction on this order

errors.name: ShipDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The ship deadline has passed: the order can only be refunded

errors.name: ShipDeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: The ship deadline has not passed yet

errors.name: ReviewWindowOpen
errors.msg: The review window after shipping is still open

errors.name: ReviewWindowClosed
errors.msg: The review window after shipping has closed

errors.name: RulingDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: T_max has passed without a ruling: the order can only be refunded

errors.name: RulingDeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: T_max has not passed yet

errors.name: TimelockActive
errors.msg: The ruling's timelock is still running

errors.name: InvalidRuling
errors.msg: A ruling is RULING_RELEASE or RULING_REFUND

errors.name: MissingReasonHash
errors.msg: A ruling must publish a non-zero reason hash

errors.name: NoProposal
errors.msg: No settlement proposal is open

errors.name: ProposalMismatch
errors.msg: The proposal differs from the amount the signer agreed to

errors.name: OwnProposal

errors.name: SettlementTooLarge
errors.msg: A settlement cannot give the buyer more than the deposit

errors.name: MissingTokenAccount

errors.name: OfferNotExpired

errors.name: MathOverflow

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: Seeds `["config"]`, singleton, created once by the program's upgrade authority. It has no setter:
nothing in this program can change the offer key, the arbiter, the fee recipient or the mints.
Layout (after the 8-byte discriminator): offer_key @8 (32) · arbiter @40 (32) · fee_recipient @72 (32)
· mints @104 (2 × 32) · bump @168 (u8) · fee_vault_bumps @169 (2 × u8) → 171 bytes.

fields.name: offer_key
docs: Ed25519 key of FlaconVault that signs order terms (`open_and_deposit`). It cannot move funds.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: May open a dispute on a shipped order and rule RELEASE or REFUND on a disputed one.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Owner of the token accounts `collect_fees` forwards the fee vaults to.

fields.name: mints
docs: Allowed mints: `[USDC, EURC]` (classic SPL Token, 6 decimals).

fields.name: fee_vault_bumps
docs: Bumps of the fee vaults `["fees", mints[i]]`.

types.name: MarketOrder
docs: Seeds `["morder", buyer, order_id]` (`order_id`: 16 random bytes, not the marketplace order number).
Layout (after the 8-byte discriminator):
order_id @8 (16) · buyer @24 (32) · seller @56 (32) · mint @88 (32) · rent_payer @120 (32)
· amount @152 (u64) · buyer_fee @160 (u64) · seller_fee @168 (u64) · lane @176 (u8) · state @177 (u8)
· resolution @178 (u8) · review_window_s @179 (u32) · ruling_window_s @183 (u32) · timelock_s @187 (u32)
· ship_deadline @191 (i64) · offer_expiry @199 (i64) · opened_at @207 (i64) · shipped_at @215 (i64)
· disputed_at @223 (i64) · disputed_by @231 (u8) · ruled_at @232 (i64) · ruling @240 (u8)
· reason_hash @241 (32) · proposal_by @273 (u8) · proposal_to_buyer @274 (u64) · ended_at @282 (i64)
· bump @290 (u8) · vault_bump @291 (u8) → 292 bytes.

fields.name: seller
docs: The seller's own wallet (from the signed offer); proceeds go to its associated token account.

fields.name: mint
docs: USDC or EURC.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent of this account and of the vault; gets it back at `close_order`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Item price in base units.

fields.name: buyer_fee
docs: Buyer protection, paid by the buyer on top of `amount`.

fields.name: seller_fee
docs: Seller commission, deducted from `amount` on release.

fields.name: lane
docs: `LANE_*`

fields.name: state
docs: `STATE_*`

fields.name: resolution
docs: `RESOLUTION_*` (set with the terminal state).

fields.name: review_window_s
docs: Review window after `mark_shipped`, fixed by the lane.

fields.name: ruling_window_s
docs: T_max after `dispute` (signed).

fields.name: timelock_s
docs: Timelock after `rule` (signed).

fields.name: ship_deadline
docs: After this instant `mark_shipped` is closed and the buyer can be refunded (signed).

fields.name: offer_expiry
docs: Expiry of the signed offer; the account can be closed only after it (no replay of the offer).

fields.name: disputed_by
docs: `PARTY_BUYER` or `PARTY_ARBITER`.

fields.name: ruling
docs: `RULING_*`

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Hash of the published reasons of the ruling.

fields.name: proposal_by
docs: `PARTY_BUYER` / `PARTY_SELLER` of the open settlement proposal, `PARTY_NONE` if there is none.

fields.name: proposal_to_buyer
docs: Base units the proposal gives the buyer; the rest of the deposit goes to the seller.

fields.name: ended_at
docs: When the terminal state was reached.

types.name: OfferArgs
docs: Order terms as signed by the offer key (buyer and mint come from the accounts).

fields.name: order_id
docs: 16 random bytes chosen by the server; part of the order PDA seeds.

types.name: OrderRefunded
docs: The buyer got the whole deposit back.

types.name: OrderReleased
docs: The seller was paid (`to_seller`) and the fees went to the fee vault (`fees`).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: Singleton config `["config"]`.

constants.name: FEE_VAULT_SEED
docs: Fee vault: SPL token account `["fees", mint]`, authority = the config PDA (one per allowed mint).

constants.name: LANE_A
docs: Lane A (photos): review window 14 days after `mark_shipped`.

constants.name: LANE_G
docs: Lane G (inspection hub): not available with crypto until the hub steps are on chain (§7.2).

constants.name: LANE_S
docs: Lane S (sealed bottle): review window 10 days after `mark_shipped`.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Buyer fee and seller commission are each capped at 20 % of the item amount, so even a misused
offer key cannot sign away the seller's proceeds.

constants.name: MAX_OFFER_TTL_S
docs: A signed offer may be valid for at most one hour (the USDC rate holds 10 minutes, §7.1).

constants.name: MINT_DECIMALS
docs: Allowed mints: classic SPL Token mints with 6 decimals (USDC, EURC).

constants.name: MIN_RULING_WINDOW_S
docs: T_max: the arbiter must rule within 7 ..= 60 days (signed per order) after the dispute opened.

constants.name: MIN_SHIP_WINDOW_S
docs: The signed ship deadline must lie 1 ..= 30 days after `open_and_deposit`.

constants.name: MIN_TIMELOCK_S
docs: Timelock between `rule` and `execute_ruling`: 48 ..= 72 h (signed per order).

constants.name: OFFER_MSG_LEN
docs: Length of the signed offer message (see `offer.rs`).

constants.name: OFFER_PREFIX
docs: Domain prefix of the signed offer message (8 bytes).

constants.name: ORDER_SEED
docs: `MarketOrder` `["morder", buyer, order_id (16 random bytes)]`.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_CONFIRMED
docs: `confirm` by the buyer.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_RULING_REFUND
docs: `execute_ruling` of a REFUND ruling.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_RULING_RELEASE
docs: `execute_ruling` of a RELEASE ruling.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_SETTLEMENT
docs: `accept_settlement`.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_TMAX
docs: `refund_after_tmax`: no ruling by T_max.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_UNSHIPPED
docs: `refund_unshipped`.

constants.name: RESOLUTION_WINDOW
docs: `release_after_window`.

constants.name: REVIEW_WINDOW_S_LANE_A
docs: Review window after `mark_shipped`, lane A.

constants.name: REVIEW_WINDOW_S_LANE_S
docs: Review window after `mark_shipped`, lane S.

constants.name: STATE_DISPUTED
docs: Halted by `dispute`; waits for a ruling, a settlement or `refund_after_tmax`.

constants.name: STATE_PAID
docs: Funded, waiting for `mark_shipped`.

constants.name: STATE_REFUNDED
docs: Terminal: the buyer got the whole deposit back.

constants.name: STATE_RELEASED
docs: Terminal: the seller was paid, the fees went to the fee vault.

constants.name: STATE_RULED
docs: The arbiter ruled; the timelock runs, then `execute_ruling`. A settlement is still possible.

constants.name: STATE_SETTLED
docs: Terminal: buyer and seller split the deposit (no fees).

constants.name: STATE_SHIPPED
docs: Shipped, the buyer's review window runs.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Order vault: SPL token account `["vault", order]`, authority = the order PDA.
